This plot is small, only about a quarter hectare, and it is beans — not maize. The FISP coupon, if I get one, goes to my maize plot first, not to beans. Beans fix their own nitrogen in the soil, I have seen this from my father's time, so I do not waste money on fertilizer bags for them. I will put some manure from my goats if I have any left after the maize plot, use seed I saved from last harvest, and weed with my wife and children — no money to hire people for such a small piece.
